label: SonicWall TZ470 firewall
description: Desktop branch NGFW (Gen 7) with ten interfaces: X0 LAN/management, X1 and X2 WAN, X3-X7 as 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, and X8/X9 as SFP/SFP+ cages for 2.5, 5 or 10 GbE optics. 2.5 Gbps threat prevention, 1.5 million connections, RJ45 console.
notes: SonicWall TZ Series (Gen 7) datasheet: '8x1GbE, 2x2.5/5/10GbE', and the TZ470 rear panel labels X0 (LAN/MGMT) and X1/X2 (WAN) as RJ45, X3-X7 as RJ45, X8/X9 as SFP/SFP+. Both SFP+ cages are modelled at 2.5/5/10G rather than as 1G copper because that is what the datasheet sells. 2.5 Gbps max threat prevention, 1.5M max connections, built-in plus expandable storage to 256 GB, optional second PSU; the TZ470W variant adds 802.11ac Wave 2 radios, which this (non-W) model does not have. 10 GbE on copper is not offered on this box - the multi-gig ports are the two SFP+ cages.
